answer_1.quote: Our work leverages recent breakthroughs in foundation models for voice cloning... enabling us to generate high quality speech while applying fine-grained emotion controls.

answer_2.quote: We follow previous voice cloning work on measuring word error rate (WER) and speaker similarity (SIM).

answer_4.quote: We asked one question for each emotion and each metric to 23 university student volunteers from our lab and recruited on campus.
answer_4.guideline: Participants compare audio samples and select which better conveys the emotion based on evaluation metrics such as ESA, EEA, EDT, EIT, ESC, EEC, EST.
